newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 98-day T-bills yield 8.240 pct at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ 98-day T-bills yield 8.240 pct at tender.

text.p: The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 98-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 8.240 percent versus 8.470 percent for the NZ$75 million of a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.
The average yield for NZ$75 million of 189-day bills was 7.833 percent versus 8.010 percent for the $75 million of similar treasury bills at the last tender.
The average yield for $50 million of 378-day bills was 7.599 percent versus 7.732 percent for the $50 million of similar treasury bills tendered last week.
